g.text: 1.25M location writes/sec dominate; ride matching (120/sec peak) is comparatively tiny
orange = rider; blue dots = drivers streaming updates
center + 8 neighbor cells queried, not all 5M drivers
Atomic claim (prevents two riders matching one driver):
UPDATE drivers SET status='claimed' WHERE id=? AND
status='available' -- 0 rows affected = someone else won,
re-match immediately against the next-nearest candidate.
